```{r}
library(phangorn)

my_tree <- read.tree("/Users/yjkang/Desktop/EAAF_HMM/DataAvailability/Zenodo/01_wetland_Avian_diversity/bird_tree.tre")
```

```{r taxonomy}
# Harmonise survey names to BirdTree (Jetz et al. 2012) taxonomy.
# Genus changes / spelling: one-to-one renames.
# Lumps: BirdTree treats these as one species, so both survey taxa map to a single tip.
birdtree_syn <- c(
  "Ardea alba"              = "Casmerodius albus",       # genus
  "Cecropis daurica"        = "Hirundo daurica",         # genus
  "Egretta intermedia"      = "Mesophoyx intermedia",    # genus
  "Luscinia cyanura"        = "Tarsiger cyanurus",       # genus
  "Microscelis amaurotis"   = "Ixos amaurotis",          # genus
  "Tetrastes bonasia"       = "Bonasa bonasia",          # genus
  "Larus cachinans"         = "Larus cachinnans",        # typo in survey data
  "Pernis ptilorhynchus"    = "Pernis ptilorhyncus",     # BirdTree spelling
  "Motacilla alba lugens"   = "Motacilla alba",          # subspecies -> species
  "Acrocephalus orientalis" = "Acrocephalus stentoreus", # lump
  "Cuculus hyperythrus"     = "Cuculus fugax",           # lump
  "Turdus eunomus"          = "Turdus naumanni",         # lump
  "Zoothera aurea"          = "Zoothera dauma")          # lump

df <- df %>%
  mutate(Scientific_Name = trimws(Scientific_Name),
         Tree_Name = gsub(" ", "_", dplyr::recode(Scientific_Name, !!!birdtree_syn)))

# Every survey taxon must now be a tip in the tree; stop rather than drop silently.
unmatched <- setdiff(unique(df$Tree_Name), my_tree$tip.label)
if (length(unmatched) > 0) stop("Not in BirdTree: ", paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "))
```

```{r community_matrix}
# Community matrix: rows = Site_Year (one survey), cols = species, values = presence/absence.
# Lumps can put two survey taxa into one tip within the same survey, so binarise after renaming.
comm_matrix <- as.data.frame.matrix(
  table(paste(df$Wetland_Name, df$Year, sep = "_"), df$Tree_Name))
comm_matrix[comm_matrix > 0] <- 1

# Prune tree to the regional pool (all species recorded across the 13 wetlands).
matched_data <- match.phylo.comm(my_tree, comm_matrix)
clean_tree <- matched_data$phy
clean_comm_matrix <- matched_data$comm
stopifnot(ncol(clean_comm_matrix) == ncol(comm_matrix))   # nothing dropped

# Pairwise phylogenetic distance = summed branch length between tips
# (~ 2 x divergence time in Myr on this time-calibrated tree).
phylo_dist_matrix <- cophenetic(clean_tree)
```

==========================================
THE 999-ITERATION NULL MODELS for SES. MPD
==========================================
```{r}
#Running 999-iteration Null Model for Avian SES.MPD...\n
set.seed(2026)
ses_mpd_out <- ses.mpd(clean_comm_matrix, phylo_dist_matrix, null.model = "taxa.labels", abundance.weighted = FALSE, runs = 999)
ses_mpd_df <- ses_mpd_out %>%
     tibble::rownames_to_column("Site_Year") %>%
     mutate(Wetland_KR = sub("_[0-9]{4}$", "", Site_Year),
            Year       = as.integer(sub("^.*_", "", Site_Year)),
            Wetland    = wetland_names_en[Wetland_KR],
            SES_MPD    = mpd.obs.z)
ses_mpd_df
```

```{r}
#combine climate variables and species diversity
library(ncdf4)

nc_files <- list(
  "Annual Precipitation (mm)" = "/Users/yjkang/Desktop/EAAF_HMM/DataAvailability/Zenodo/01_wetland_Avian_diversity/강수량_MKPRISMv21_skorea_RN_gridraw_yearly_2000_2019.nc",
  "Maximum Dry Spell Length (days)" = "/Users/yjkang/Desktop/EAAF_HMM/DataAvailability/Zenodo/01_wetland_Avian_diversity/최대무강수지속기간_MKPRISMv21_skorea_CDD_gridraw_yearly_2000_2019.nc",
  "Heatwave Days (days)" = "/Users/yjkang/Desktop/EAAF_HMM/DataAvailability/Zenodo/01_wetland_Avian_diversity/폭염일수_MKPRISMv21_skorea_HW33_gridraw_yearly_2000_2019.nc",
  "Average Wind Speed (m/s)" = "/Users/yjkang/Desktop/EAAF_HMM/DataAvailability/Zenodo/01_wetland_Avian_diversity/풍속_MKPRISMv21_skorea_WS_gridraw_yearly_2000_2019.nc",
  "Coldwave Days (days)" = "/Users/yjkang/Desktop/EAAF_HMM/DataAvailability/Zenodo/01_wetland_Avian_diversity/한파일수_MKPRISMv21_skorea_CWm12_gridraw_yearly_2000_2019.nc"
)

extract_climate_data <- function(df, max_radius = 15) {
  # Define the fill value used in MK-PRISM (usually -9990)
  FILL_VALUE_THRESHOLD <- -9000 

  for (var_name in names(nc_files)) {
    filename <- nc_files[[var_name]]
    df[[var_name]] <- NA
    
    if (!file.exists(filename)) {
      message(paste("File not found, skipping:", filename))
      next
    }

    nc_data <- nc_open(filename)
    lats <- ncvar_get(nc_data, "latitude")
    lons <- ncvar_get(nc_data, "longitude")
    var_id <- names(nc_data$var)[1] 
    
    time_units <- ncatt_get(nc_data, "time", "units")$value
    base_year <- ifelse(grepl("2014", time_units), 2014, 2000)
    
    message(paste("Extracting variable:", var_name))

    for (i in 1:nrow(df)) {
      target_lat <- df$Latitude[i]
      target_lon <- df$Longitude[i]
      target_year <- df$Year[i]
      
      if (is.na(target_lat) || is.na(target_lon) || is.na(target_year)) next
      
      # 1. Find the initial mathematically closest pixel
      lat_idx <- which.min(abs(lats - target_lat))
      lon_idx <- which.min(abs(lons - target_lon))
      time_idx <- (target_year - base_year) + 1

      # Ensure year is within NetCDF bounds
      if (time_idx >= 1 && time_idx <= nc_data$dim$time$len) {
        
        found_valid <- FALSE
        
        # 2. Start Buffered Search (Radius 0 to max_radius)
        # Radius 0 is the exact point. Radius 1 is a 3x3 grid, etc.
        for (r in 0:max_radius) {
          # Define window boundaries
          start_lon <- max(1, lon_idx - r)
          start_lat <- max(1, lat_idx - r)
          # Determine width/height of the window
          count_lon <- min(nc_data$dim$longitude$len - start_lon + 1, (2 * r) + 1)
          count_lat <- min(nc_data$dim$latitude$len - start_lat + 1, (2 * r) + 1)
          # Extract the window/block for that specific time index
          window_data <- ncvar_get(nc_data, varid = var_id, 
                                   start = c(start_lon, start_lat, time_idx), 
                                   count = c(count_lon, count_lat, 1))
          # Filter for valid land values (ignoring fill values like -9990)
          valid_values <- window_data[window_data > FILL_VALUE_THRESHOLD]
          if (length(valid_values) > 0) {
            # Use the average of valid points found at the closest possible radius
            df[[var_name]][i] <- mean(valid_values, na.rm = TRUE)
            found_valid <- TRUE
            break # Exit the radius loop once data is found
          }
        }
        if (!found_valid) {
          message(paste("No valid land data within", max_radius, "pixels for:", df$Wetland_KR[i], "in", target_year))
        }
      }
    }
    nc_close(nc_data)
  }
  return(df)
}

# Run the extraction (this might take a few moments depending on dataset size)
birds_final <- extract_climate_data(birds_df)
# Drop temporary merge column
birds_final <- birds_final %>% select(-Wetland_KR)

# Export curated files
#write_csv(birds_final, "bird_phylo_traj_climate_fullnames_R.csv")
```

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(car)
library(nlme)   # lme() with within-site temporal correlation (corCAR1)

rename_map <- c(
  "sDTN" = "Spring_Mean_DTN",
  "AP" = "Annual.Precipitation..mm.", 
  "Dry" = "Maximum.Dry.Spell.Length..days.", 
  "Heatw" = "Heatwave.Days..days.", #"Heatwave Days (days)",
  "WS" = "Average.Wind.Speed..m.s.", #"Average Wind Speed (m/s)",
  "Coldw" = "Coldwave.Days..days.", #"Coldwave Days (days)",
  "WTemp" = "Mean_Water_Temp",	
  "pH" = "Mean_pH",	
  "BOD" = "Mean_BOD",	
  "sDO" = "Summer_Min_DO"	)

#Filtering out dropped vars, omitting NAs, and scaling
vars_to_keep <- names(rename_map)

prepare_data <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    rename(any_of(rename_map)) %>%
    select(SES_MPD, Wetland, Year, all_of(vars_to_keep)) %>%   # keep Year for the temporal correlation
    filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%  # Drop rows with NA values
    mutate(Year    = as.numeric(Year),                         # corCAR1 needs numeric time
           Wetland = factor(Wetland),
           across(all_of(vars_to_keep), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)))) # Z-score as plain numeric (scale() returns a matrix, which nlme handles poorly)
}

birds_clean <- prepare_data(birds_df)

# corCAR1 requires one observation per Wetland x Year (one survey = one row)
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(birds_clean[c("Wetland", "Year")])))

cat("\n=== Checking VIF for the 7 Variables ===\n")
vif_model <- lm(SES_MPD ~ sDTN+ AP+ Dry + Heatw + WS + Coldw + WTemp + pH + BOD + sDO, data = birds_clean) 
print(car::vif(vif_model))
# Note: Variables with a VIF > 5 are highly collinear and should be dropped before running Mixed-Effects Model
```

```{r}
# main model (wetland random intercept only):
orig_bird_lmm <- lmer(SES_MPD ~ sDTN+ AP+ Dry + Heatw + WS + Coldw + WTemp + pH + BOD + sDO + (1 | Wetland), data = birds_clean)

# siteXtime correlation check
bird_lmm <- lme(SES_MPD ~ sDTN + AP + Dry + Heatw + WS + Coldw + WTemp + pH + BOD + sDO,
                random      = ~ 1 | Wetland,
                correlation = corCAR1(form = ~ Year | Wetland),
                data        = birds_clean,
                method      = "REML")
print(summary(orig_bird_lmm))   # Phi under "Correlation Structure" = correlation between surveys 1 year apart

# For the reviewer response: same model without temporal correlation, fitted in nlme so AICs are comparable
bird_lmm0 <- lme(SES_MPD ~ sDTN + AP + Dry + Heatw + WS + Coldw + WTemp + pH + BOD + sDO,
                 random = ~ 1 | Wetland, data = birds_clean, method = "REML")
print(AIC(bird_lmm0, bird_lmm))
```

```{r}
cat("\n=== Supporting results: corCAR1 vs random-intercept model ===\n")

# 1. Estimated Phi and the correlation it implies at the revisit gaps in the model data
phi <- coef(bird_lmm$modelStruct$corStruct, unconstrained = FALSE)
gaps <- birds_clean %>%
  arrange(Wetland, Year) %>%
  group_by(Wetland) %>%
  mutate(gap = Year - lag(Year)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gap)) %>%
  pull(gap)
gap_tab <- as.data.frame(table(gap_years = gaps)) %>%
  mutate(gap_years    = as.numeric(as.character(gap_years)),
         implied_corr = phi^gap_years) %>%
  rename(n_revisits = Freq)
cat(sprintf("\nPhi (correlation between surveys 1 year apart) = %.4f\n", phi))
cat("Implied residual correlation at the observed revisit gaps:\n")
print(gap_tab, digits = 3)

# 2. Log-likelihood and AIC
ll0 <- logLik(bird_lmm0); ll1 <- logLik(bird_lmm)
cat("\nModel fit:\n")
print(data.frame(model  = c("Random intercept", "Random intercept + corCAR1"),
                 n_par  = c(attr(ll0, "df"), attr(ll1, "df")),
                 logLik = round(c(ll0, ll1), 3),
                 AIC    = round(c(AIC(bird_lmm0), AIC(bird_lmm)), 3)))

# 3. Fixed effects side by side: original lmer model vs corCAR1 model
tt_ri  <- summary(orig_bird_lmm)$coefficients   # lmerTest table
tt_car <- summary(bird_lmm)$tTable              # nlme table
comp <- data.frame(Est_RI  = tt_ri[, "Estimate"],   Est_CAR1 = tt_car[, "Value"],
                   SE_RI   = tt_ri[, "Std. Error"], SE_CAR1  = tt_car[, "Std.Error"],
                   t_RI    = tt_ri[, "t value"],    t_CAR1   = tt_car[, "t-value"])
cat("\nFixed effects (RI = random intercept, CAR1 = + corCAR1):\n")
print(round(comp, 4))

# 4. Largest absolute differences between the two models
cat(sprintf("\nMax |difference|: estimate = %.1e, SE = %.1e, t = %.1e\n",
            max(abs(comp$Est_RI - comp$Est_CAR1)),
            max(abs(comp$SE_RI  - comp$SE_CAR1)),
            max(abs(comp$t_RI   - comp$t_CAR1))))
```

```{r, fig.width= 8.7, fig.height=4.1, message=FALSE}
library(tidyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggpmisc)

rename_map <- c(
  "Annual Precip (mm)" = "Annual.Precipitation..mm.", 
  "Max Dry Spell (days)" = "Maximum.Dry.Spell.Length..days.", 
  "Heatwaves (days)" = "Heatwave.Days..days.", #"Heatwave Days (days)",
  "Coldwaves (days)" = "Coldwave.Days..days.", #"Coldwave Days (days)",
  "Wind Speed (m/s)" = "Average.Wind.Speed..m.s.", #"Average Wind Speed (m/s)",
  "Water Temp (°C)" = "Mean_Water_Temp",	
  "Mean Water pH" = "Mean_pH",	
  "BOD (mg/L)" = "Mean_BOD",	
  "Summer DO (mg/L)" = "Summer_Min_DO",
  "Spring DTN (mg/L)" = "Spring_Mean_DTN" )
long_names<- names(rename_map)

plot_climate_correlations <- function(df, title_prefix, point_color) {
  
  df_clean <- df %>%
    rename(any_of(rename_map)) %>%
    select(SES_MPD, all_of(long_names)) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%
    # Pivot the data into a "long" format, which is required for ggplot faceting
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(long_names), 
                 names_to = "Climate_Variable", 
                 values_to = "Value")
    #df_clean$Climate_Variable <- factor(df_clean$Climate_Variable, levels = long_names)
    df_clean$Climate_Variable <- gsub(" \\(", "\n\\(", df_clean$Climate_Variable)
    wrapped_levels <- gsub(" \\(", "\n\\(", long_names)
    df_clean$Climate_Variable <- factor(df_clean$Climate_Variable, levels = wrapped_levels)
  
  p <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = Value, y = SES_MPD)) +
    geom_point(color = point_color, alpha = 0.7, size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))) +
    stat_correlation(use_label("R", "R.CI"), size=2.5) +
    #stat_cor(method = "pearson", label.x.npc = 0.02, label.y.npc = 0, size = 3.7) + 
    facet_wrap(~ Climate_Variable, scales = "free_x", ncol = 5, 
               labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 22)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off")+
    labs(
      title = paste("Potential Environmental Drivers of Wetland", title_prefix ,"Diversity"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Phylogenetic Diversity (SES-MPD)"
    ) +
    theme_bw() + # Clean white background theme
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  return(p) }

bird_plot <- plot_climate_correlations(birds_df, "Bird", "dodgerblue3")
print(bird_plot)
#ggsave("/Users/yjkang/Desktop/Bird_Climate_Correlations.pdf", plot = bird_plot, width = 8.7, height = 4.1)
```
